findings.problem: The trick says Onkel is almost uncle said backwards, which is false: it sounds like uncle said forwards, and the backwards claim would confuse learners.
findings.fix: trick: Onkel sounds almost exactly like uncle with an o at the front: your Onkel is your uncle.

note: The plural die Onkels is also common in casual speech, but die Onkel is the standard form, so the card is fine as it is.
